channel.title: The Many Days of Anzac
channel.desc: The ABC dives into its archives of its Anzac Day coverage to reveal the story of how Australians created Anzac traditions and rituals by which we remember those who fought.

channel.name: ABC AU
channel.title: Last Post - Winds of Change
channel.desc: The Last Post - Winds of Change is a moving tribute to First Nations peoples who have fought for their country. Performed by Yamatji, Widi and Wongi didgeridoo player Mark Atkins and virtuoso James Morrison.

channel.title: Anzac Dawn Service From Sydney
channel.desc: The ABC's all-day coverage of Anzac Day events begins with the Anzac Dawn Service from the Cenotaph in Sydney's Martin Place. Presented by Fauziah Ibrahim.

channel.title: Anzac Dawn Service From Canberra
channel.desc: As Dawn breaks, the ABC takes you to Canberra for the National Anzac Dawn Service from the Australian War Memorial. Presented by Fauziah Ibrahim.

channel.title: Anzac Dawn Service From Melbourne
channel.desc: Melbourne's Anzac Dawn Service from the Shrine of Remembrance. The Dawn Service is a solemn and reflective ceremony to remember and recognise the service and sacrifice of members of the Australian Defence Force.

channel.name: ABC AU
channel.title: Anzac Dawn Service From Adelaide 2026
